### Apify trend scraper
EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: an Apify actor for trend data. Set `APIFY_TOKEN`, `APIFY_TRENDS_ACTOR_ID`, optional `APIFY_TRENDS_INPUT_JSON`. Without them this workflow does nothing (the 08:00 controller reports missing config). Check the platform terms of the sites you scrape before enabling.
